Support

Something not working, or a question we haven’t answered below? Email contact@dunkstone.com. It helps if you include:

  • the support code from the game’s Settings
  • your device model and iOS version
  • what happened, and what you expected

We read every message and usually reply within a few working days.

Questions

I bought Remove Ads or gold. How do I get it back?

Remove Ads comes back with Settings › Purchases › Restore purchases, signed in with the same Apple Account you bought it with. Gold is used up as you spend it, so it isn’t restored. If a purchase went through but the gold never arrived, email us with your support code.

What does Remove Ads do?

It stops the ads that show between runs. Ads you choose to watch, for a Continue or Double Gold, stay available, because they’re always your choice.

Where is my progress saved?

On your device. There’s no account or cloud save, so deleting the game deletes your progress, gold and collection. Remove Ads can still be restored.

How do I change my privacy or tracking choices?

Where the law gives you these choices, the game’s Settings shows Privacy choices or Your Privacy Choices. Tracking on iPhone is in iOS Settings › Privacy & Security › Tracking.

How do I ask you to delete my data?

Email contact@dunkstone.com with the support code from Settings. It’s the only thing that links your analytics and crash reports to you. The privacy policy says what we collect.

Can I get a refund?

Apple handles payments and refunds. Ask at reportaproblem.apple.com.
